Boarding & care

A place for your horse to thrive.

Individual daily care, turnout and professional equestrian facilities in Ortho. Talk to the Prepinson team about your horse.

Discuss your horse’s needs

Daily care

Attentive daily care and individual attention are at the heart of life at Prepinson. Daily turnout and a calm environment give each horse room to develop at its own pace.

Meet the whole team

Space to move and work

The 30-hectare estate combines pastures, an indoor arena and an outdoor arena. Training and rides in the surrounding forests complement life at the stable. Discover the facilities and our young horse programmes.
